scope: Full campaign source/data/architecture/preproduction from F1-01 through F3-07 while UE4 runner is unavailable. Runtime chapter expansion is forbidden.

authority_order: Current project rules / approved implementation decisions
Tolkien The Lord of the Rings + Appendices
source_governance.rotk_supersession: Source 11 states that the Return of the King screenplay is now present and supersedes older Sources 01-07 notes that ROTK lacked a screenplay. Future ROTK verification must use supplied ROTK screenplay + film before old MASTER-SUMMARY shorthand.

path_and_story_findings.finding: WholeGameChapterAssetDemandMatrixV1 contained future/other-chapter asset pollution (Bree+Ent demand in F1-03, Ent in unrelated chapters, Mordor/Black Gate/lava in Amon Hen and Pelennor, active siege demand in Return/Farewell).
path_and_story_findings.risk: Wrong warehouse acquisition, inflated future streaming banks, and accidental chapter visual/state contamination.
path_and_story_findings.repair: Reconcile all 23 rows to WholeGameChapterProductionPacketsV1 source location/focus/outcome; remove the concrete cross-chapter families; add a hosted regression guard.

path_and_story_findings.finding: GlobalWarehouseSourceRegistryV2 declared source_count=102 while its sources array contained 142 unique entries.
path_and_story_findings.risk: Manager/automation can undercount source coverage and make incorrect saturation decisions.
path_and_story_findings.repair: Set declared count from actual array and guard exact equality.

path_and_story_findings.finding: Post-Amon-Hen route graph already uses independent Rohan/Ring-bearer/Gondor/Rohan-late lanes with synchronization barriers.
path_and_story_findings.risk: A future lane that advances a shared world state early would corrupt chronology and save continuity.
path_and_story_findings.repair: No redesign. Keep Data/WholeGameRoutePromotionGraphV1.json as the preparation graph and require barrier/state checks before any future runtime promotion.

quest_story.note: No second quest/story authority is authorized by this audit.

world_commit.note: GetAllActorsOfClass cleanup scans occur in chapter transition cleanup, not normal per-frame traversal. This is not accepted as hitch-free until measured on target hardware.

streaming.evidence: Reviewed implementation has zero LoadObject/StaticLoadObject calls and uses FStreamableManager RequestAsyncLoad paths.
streaming.risk: Cold/warm residency, first-use render/PSO, VRAM pressure and cancellation timing still require runner/device evidence.

living_world.evidence: Population/event work is commit-gated; maintenance is bounded at 0.75s; ambient NPC/interactions/motion have pools. Persistent ambient TActorIterator reconciliation occurs on committed chapter reset, not per frame.
living_world.risk: Transition reset and activation bursts still require frame-time tail measurement.

npc_context.evidence: Social/dialogue/mood data loads once; committed chapter/route/episode/quest context is stored without world actor scans; dialogue is suppressed while logical world identity is uncommitted.
npc_context.interaction_with_living_world: Director queries bounded context state; NPCContext never owns population spawning. No per-frame full-world context rebuild was found in the reviewed path.

persistence.evidence: Automatic checkpoints use AsyncSaveGameToSlot and preserve captured snapshot/world revision.
persistence.risk: User QuickSave/QuickLoad still uses synchronous SaveGameToSlot/LoadGameFromSlot. Treat as a target-device hitch risk, not a confirmed defect, until measured; do not rewrite without evidence.

player_visual_fallback.note: Prototype style can synchronously LoadObject only the engine BasicShapeMaterial fallback. This is not a heavy production asset load; heavy production character assets remain separate async paths.

physical_visual_performance_boundary: Static reasoning cannot prove collision-free traversal, visual artifact absence, audio quality, no hitching, no shader/streaming stutter, or 30 FPS.
Those remain runner/PIE/target-device/human evidence items and must be executed chapter-by-chapter under the One-Shot model.
The purpose of this audit is to eliminate source/data/architecture mistakes before expensive chapter execution.

warehouse_findings.meaning: The repository has broad static-source stock but a very small final animated FBX footprint. Warehouse growth should prioritize reusable rig/animation/creature/audio/world hero gaps rather than more blind static duplication.

branch_hygiene.rule: Only the existing fail-closed hosted branch cleanup script may delete reviewed refs; unique Edoras source-prep branches remain preserved until selective reconciliation.

runner_return_handoff: When UE4-27-Windows returns, stop this exceptional whole-game offline lane as the primary activity and execute Data/P1C01RunnerHandoffV1.json without replanning. P1C01 remains the sole runtime-changing chapter.
evidence_boundary: STATIC/SOURCE AUDIT ONLY. No PIE/device/visual/audio/performance/Gate 6/7 acceptance.
